brief: Holds a sequence of samples and answers what frequencies it is made of: its spectrum, magnitudes, phases, dominant frequency and convolution.
detail: Build one with new stzFourier(aSamples), numbers or [ re, im ] pairs. Any length is transformed exactly, with a radix-2 FFT for a power of two and Bluestein's algorithm for the others, and never padded. The convention is NumPy's: the forward transform is unscaled, the inverse carries the 1/n. The Transform, Magnitudes, Phases and PowerSpectrum answers have one entry per bin; bin 1 holds the mean. Content, Real and Imaginary give back the samples. InverseTransform inverts the sequence it holds, which is the spectrum when you built the object from one.
